hints.title: Complete Component Definition
hints.text: A connected component with k vertices is complete if and only if every pair of vertices shares an edge, meaning it contains k * (k - 1) // 2 edges.

hints.title: Component Traversal
hints.text: Use breadth or depth traversal from unvisited vertices to extract vertex count and edge count for each component.

hints.title: Clique Verification
hints.text: Compare the actual number of unique edges in the component to k * (k - 1) // 2.

hints.title: Component Exploration and Edge Count Implementation

complexity.notes: Breadth component traversal followed by edge count verification.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all vertex pairs individually is O(V^3) whereas component aggregation is O(V + E).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(V + E) memory for adjacency list and visited flags.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies that a k-vertex complete graph has exactly k * (k - 1) // 2 edges.
